cross_scenario_incumbent.rule: Recalculate sales auxiliary variables under the target demand before use; planting areas and hard agricultural constraints are unchanged.

per_target.stage1: maximize target-scenario S1 profit, warm-started by the D05/S1 planting plan; 180 seconds; target relative MIP gap 1%
per_target.stage2: retain at least 99.9% of the better of the transferred incumbent and stage-1 incumbent, then minimize activation count; 60 seconds
per_target.stage3: fix the best stage-2 activation count, maximize profit, and canonicalize full-sales variables; 45 seconds

work_packages.name: selection, independent verification, and S1 draft update
work_packages.selection: For each target, retain only a zero-violation solution. Prefer higher independently recomputed target profit; when profit differs by at most 0.1%, prefer fewer activations.
checks: independent target-scenario revenue and cost recalculation
all Q1 hard constraints and frozen hashes
comparison with M0, old M1R3, and the transferred D05 incumbent
D0/D05/D10 S1 cross-evaluation and scenario-similarity refresh
work_packages.draft_rule: Create result1_1_Q1-DRAFT-v2.xlsx only if the selected D0/S1 planting plan changes; independently re-read all seven sheets and compare every nonzero cell with CSV. Do not edit or regenerate the S2 workbook.

success_and_fallback: A retained target solution must have zero independently detected hard-constraint violations and accounting discrepancy no more than 0.1 yuan.
Never retain a target solution with lower target-scenario profit than the transferred D05 incumbent unless applying the explicit within-0.1% management tie rule.
If no reliable improvement is found, retain the transferred incumbent or existing valid solution and report the failed search.
Report MIP status, bound, gap, time, activation count, and maximum plots per crop-season; do not claim global optimality beyond the recorded gap.
stop_conditions: Stop on frozen-hash mismatch, infeasible warm start, hard-constraint violation, or profit discrepancy above 0.1 yuan.
Do not start another solve when the 12-minute wall budget would be exceeded; preserve completed evidence.
After verification stop at D. Do not freeze Q1 or enter Q2 without a new explicit user decision.
